scope: Eight predeclared integration briefs on renamed authored layouts; one attempt each. Not a general accuracy benchmark. Refusals and errors retained.

response.explanation: Set total on-time to 23, per-house floor to 3, wait cap to 5, kept edits to one bridge move or one dispatch change.
response.instruction: Require at least twenty-three water units on time, at least three at every home, and at most five total courier waiting turns. Permit either one bridge move or one dispatch change.

response.explanation: All demand on time (minimumOnTime=null) with maximumWait=4. Only edit is moving Upper ford (ford-upper), so allowDispatch=false.

response.explanation: Updated maximumWait from 8 to 2, preserving all other contract values.

response.instruction: Every water unit on time and zero total courier waiting turns. One bridge move or one dispatch change is allowed.

response.explanation: At least 23 on-time is interpretable as minimumOnTime=23, but adding a courier changes locked worker/courier count. No changes applied.
unsupported: add one more courier: courier/worker count, production, demand, deadlines, schedule and capacity are always locked

unsupported: ambiguous bridge name 'Crossing' matches multiple bridges
